title: Chained Figure with Shield
description: A dark-skinned man with golden eyes and a spiked crown kneels on the floor of a stone chamber. His hands touch the ground and a large shield that rests against his body while chains bind his arms and neck.
prompt: A dark-skinned man with golden eyes kneels on the floor inside a stone chamber with a high arched ceiling and keyhole shaped opening at the top. He wears a spiked crown and heavy chains around his neck and arms. He holds a large shield with a glowing purple spiral design on it. The floor has scattered yellow leaves a broken glass jar and coins. The walls have shelves with clocks and keys. The scene uses purple gold brown and gray colors.
